item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las yi dam gu ru drag po'i sngon 'gro bum pa'i ti ka
item.coloph: sngon 'gro dkyil 'khor gyi las rim gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba/ chu pho stag lo rta zla'i tshes 10la sum cu'i gnas na dkar mo mdangs ldan gyis/ ma 'ongs kho bo bdag la snyan du brgyud/ phyi rabs 'gro ba kun gyi don ched du/ dmu btsun sku mchog gtsug gi mtshan gyi (gyis) bskul/ rkyen gyi ngo ru phyi rabs yi ger spel/ nyes pa gang bgyis mkha' 'gro gnyen la bshags/ dge bas sems can byang chub sa thob shog/
